mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ are used in France, Britain, Germany and other European countries.
Forms of the conciliar system are used in France, Britain, Germany and other European countries.
Fill in the blank: ______ are the closest tier of government to the grassroots.
Local governments are the closest tier of government to the grassroots.
Fill in the blank: ______ are those that deal with safety of citizens i.e, police and fire services.
Protective functions are those that deal with safety of citizens i.e, police and fire services.
fib: ______ is the third tier of government mandated by law to cater for the needs of people at the grassroots.
Local government is the third tier of government mandated by law to cater for the needs of people at the grassroots.

______ means that the power of a traditional ruler to veto the decision of a Local Council; while Chief-at-Council is a situation whereby the decision of elected Councilors overwrite that of a traditional rulers.

Chief-in-Council means that the power of a traditional ruler to veto the decision of a Local Council; while Chief-at-Council is a situation whereby the decision of elected Councilors overwrite that of a traditional rulers.
______ is the greatest bane of local government administration in Nigeria.
Corruption is the greatest bane of local government administration in Nigeria.
